translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Preserved all 39 paragraphs, multi-paragraph song directions, every bracket and brace, repetitions, gender/verb shifts, clipped phrases, punctuation oddities, and seven consecutive “please” repetitions. The apparent OCR form וטפלטמו is translated contextually as “and You delivered them”; the malformed למה לו {...}, לא {..} צריכים לחיות remains correspondingly awkward.

qa.reviewNotes: Corrected one substantive repetition error: in the Meah Shearim sentence the Hebrew has exactly three successive go forms—ילך, תלך, תלך—but the staged English had four (one ‘he will go’ plus three ‘you will go’). Removed the unsupported extra ‘you will go.’ All 39 paragraph units, bracketed song turns, lyrics, braces, ellipses, clipped phrases, other repetitions, and boundary punctuation remain preserved.
